comment: URLs that are live for humans but fail automated fetching. Every entry needs: expect (the status automation receives), reason, added (date), and removal_trigger. Gates: lint-links fails when an entry is older than 30 days (re-verify and re-date, or remove); lint-links-external retries every URL 3 times before consulting this list, and probes machine-checkable removal triggers (a repo_public trigger fails the build once the repo is public and the exception is still present).

https://github.com/ANI-IN/harness/issues.reason: The repository is currently private; GitHub serves 404 to unauthenticated clients for all of its pages. Issues are enabled (verified via authenticated API).

removal_trigger.note: remove this entry when the repository is public

https://github.com/ANI-IN/harness/securi.reason: Same as above: private repo, 404 to unauthenticated clients. The /new page additionally requires login even on public repos, so after the repo goes public this link must be re-verified and this entry replaced or removed.

removal_trigger.note: remove or re-justify when the repository is public

https://openai.com/index/harness-enginee.reason: openai.com intermittently serves HTTP 403 to non-browser fetchers (bot protection); the page itself is live (it has also answered 200 to this checker). The exception only excuses a 403 that persists across all retry attempts; a dead link would return 404/410 and still fail.

removal_trigger.condition: openai.com answers 2xx to this checker consistently, or the article moves
